"Pholcodine".

DANGEROUS DRUGS ORDINANCE 1952
DANGEROUS DRUGS ORDBR 1976

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 45A of the Dangerous
Drugs Ordinance 1952, the Minister makes the following order:

1. This order may be cited as the Dangerous Drugs Order 1976.

2. Part III of the First Schedule to the Ordinance is amended by—
(a) inserting the item "Betameprodine" immediately after the item
"Betacetylmethadol";

(b) inserting the item "Bezitramide" immediately after the item
"Betaprodine"; and

(c) inserting the item "Hydromorphone" immediately after the
item "Hydromorphinol"'.

3. Part IV of the First Schedule to the Ordinance is amended by
inserting the item "Propiram" immediately after the item "Pholcodine".

Made this 20th day of September 1976.
[KKM 55 (58); PN. (PU?) 214.]

Tan Sri LEE SIOK YEw,
Minister of Health

P.U. (A) 322.
ORDINAN RACUN 1952

PERATURAN-PERATURAN RACUN (NATERIAM HAIDEROKSAID)
(PINDAAN) 1976

Papa menjalankan kuasa-kuasa yang diberi oleh seksyen 30 Ordinan
Racun 1952, Menteri membuat peraturan-peraturan yang berikut:

1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-peraturan
Racun (Nateriam Haideroksaid) (Pindaan) 1976 dan hendaklah mula
berkuatkuasa pada 14 haribulan Oktober 1976.

2. Peraturan-peraturan Racun (Nateriam Haideroksaid 1962 (kemu-
dian daripada ini disebut Peraturan-peraturan ibu) adalah dipinda
dengan memasukkan peraturan 4A yang berikut selepas peraturan 4—

"4a. A fee of one hundred ringgit shall be payable for any
permit issued under these Regulations.".

3. Jadual kepada Peraturan-peraturan ibu adalah dipinda dengan
memasukkan perkataan-perkataan "Fee $100 paid." di sebelah bawah
perkataan "Dated" dalam Borang A.

Dibuat pada 20 haribulan September 1976.
[K.K. 13088 PT. II; P.N. (PU?) 310.]       TaN Sri Leg Siok YEw,

Menteri Kesihatan

(Akan dibentangkan dalam Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen-kecil (3)
seksyen 30 Ordinan Racun 1952.)

POISONS ORDINANCE 1952
Poisons (SoprluM HyDROXxIDB) (AMBNDMENT) REGULATIONS 1976

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 30 of the Poisons
Ordinance 1952, the Minister makes the following regulations:

1. These regulations may be cited as the Poisons (Sodium Hydroxide)
(Amendment) Regulations 1976 and shall come into force on the
14th day of October 1976.
